从自行车到大模型，用可视化看懂生活和工作背后的每一步。: Visual explanations of everyday mechanisms, from bicycle gears to language models. Watch, listen and explore how each step works.
纸上的一个点，要经过一整条成像链。: One printed dot travels through an entire imaging process.
激光照的是感光鼓，纸张走另一条路。: The laser reaches the drum; paper follows a separate path.
先把鼓面充成均匀负电位。: First, give the drum an even negative potential.
曝光改变电位，先写出看不见的图案。: Exposure changes potential, creating an invisible pattern.
带电碳粉把电位图案变成可见图案。: Charged toner makes the electrical pattern visible.
显影取决于各部件之间的电位差。: Development depends on potential differences between components.
转印电场让碳粉离开鼓面，来到纸面。: The transfer field moves toner from drum to paper.
加热软化树脂，压力帮助碳粉黏合纸纤维。: Heat softens toner resin; pressure helps it bond to paper.
清掉残粉与残余电荷，鼓面才可以重新使用。: Remove leftover toner and charge before reusing the drum.
充电 → 曝光 → 显影 → 转印 → 定影。: Charge, expose, develop, transfer, then fuse.
共同节距和表面速度，让各部件配合。: Shared pitch and matched surface speeds coordinate the parts.
激光写电荷，碳粉留图案，定影让它牢固。: Light writes charge; toner forms the image; fusing makes it last.
跟住金色链节，看动力怎样绕一圈。: Follow the gold link around the drivetrain.
齿与链节共享同一个节距。: Teeth and links share the same pitch.
前链盘转一圈，拉过与齿数相同数量的链节。: One chainring turn advances one link per tooth.
后轴转速 = 踏频 × 前齿数 ÷ 后齿数。: Rear speed equals cadence times front teeth divided by rear teeth.
相同踏频，小飞轮让后轴转得更多。: At the same cadence, a smaller sprocket turns the axle faster.
同样的链条拉力，小飞轮提供的轴上扭矩更小。: For the same chain pull, a smaller sprocket gives less axle torque.
大飞轮以较低轮速换取更有利的力矩。: A larger rear sprocket trades wheel speed for torque.
坡度增加，维持相同速度需要更大的驱动力。: A steeper road requires more driving force at the same speed.
踏频改变，链速与轮速一起改变。: Changing cadence changes both chain speed and wheel speed.
省力不等于少做相同路程所需的功。: Less pedal force does not erase the work of a climb.
读数表示维持所选踏频所需的力和功率。: The readouts show the effort needed to maintain the selected cadence.
前小后大更轻，前大后小更快。: Smaller front and larger rear favor easier pedaling.
高度先储存能量，松手后开始转化。: Height stores energy that motion can release.
重力沿圆弧方向的分量，把摆球拉向最低点。: The tangential part of gravity pulls the bob toward the bottom.
最低处势能最小，速度最大。: At the bottom, potential energy is lowest and speed is highest.
到达端点，速度降到零，方向反转。: At an endpoint, speed reaches zero before reversing.
从同一位置、同一运动方向回来，才算一周期。: A full period returns to the same position and direction.
摆长增加，周期按平方根关系增大。: Period grows with the square root of length.
理想单摆里，质量改变能量，不改变周期。: In an ideal pendulum, mass changes energy, not period.
重力减弱，相同摆长的钟摆走得更慢。: Weaker gravity makes the same pendulum slower.
大摆幅会偏离小角度周期公式。: Large swings depart from the small-angle period formula.
阻尼把机械能转移给环境。: Damping transfers mechanical energy to the surroundings.
真实摆钟需要补充损耗，并保持稳定的摆动。: A real clock must replace losses and maintain a steady swing.
摆长和重力定节奏，阻尼改振幅，质量改能量尺度。: Length and gravity set the rhythm; damping changes amplitude.
冰箱把箱内的热搬到房间里。: A refrigerator moves heat from its interior into the room.
制冷剂在封闭管路中循环，正常运行不被消耗。: Refrigerant circulates in a sealed loop rather than being consumed.

冷凝器向空气放热，让蒸气凝成液体。: The condenser releases heat while vapor becomes liquid.
高压侧与低压侧，让同一种制冷剂在不同温度下换热。: High and low pressures let one refrigerant exchange heat at different temperatures.
节流降压，一部分液体闪蒸。: Throttling reduces pressure and flashes some liquid into vapor.

放到房间的热 = 箱内移出的热 + 输入电功。: Heat released equals heat removed plus electrical work.

波峰对波峰，叠加后的起伏变大。: Peak meets peak, and the combined variation grows.
相位描述两道波在周期中的相对位置。: Phase describes the waves’ relative positions in a cycle.
相同幅度、相反相位，在这个位置完全抵消。: Equal amplitudes and opposite phases cancel at this point.
相位对了，幅度不匹配仍会留下残余。: Correct phase still leaves a residual if amplitudes differ.
把幅度调回来，残余再次降低。: Matching the amplitudes reduces the residual again.
额外延迟会破坏原来的反相关系。: Extra delay breaks the original phase alignment.
同样的延迟，在高频里对应更大的相位转动。: The same delay spans more of a cycle at higher frequencies.
这个波形实验只描述一个位置的叠加。: This waveform experiment describes superposition at one point.
麦克风、控制器和扬声器持续配合。: Microphones, a controller and speakers work together continuously.

两个圆通常相交于两个候选位置。: Two circles generally leave two candidate positions.
第三个距离排除另一个交点。: A third distance removes the other intersection.

大气、反射与轨道误差还会影响真实测距。: Atmosphere, reflections and orbit errors also affect real measurements.

蓝点是多条距离与时间信息共同约束出的解。: The blue dot is a solution constrained by distance and time.

变换、量化、重建，让细节与表示成本形成取舍。: Transform, quantize and reconstruct to see the tradeoff.
